TC-14/S03.title: Begin Encounter and the Encounter tab reach the same encounter view, the tab path from a chart with no pre-round note, both modes
TC-14/S03.detail: PW, local stack, both modes (pre-round Save Note answered at the socket with an empty parse; nothing generated). On a chart with no pre-round note the Encounter tab from the tab strip shows the patient's encounter view (dictation box, Save & Extract, Generate Note & Finish, Note Format) with no Begin Encounter and no other patient; after a pre-round Save Note the Pre-Round tab offers Begin Encounter, which opens the same view with the same controls. Judged 8/8 (U1, U14). Recorded (Q10): Begin Encounter is not offered on a chart that has no pre-round note yet, in either mode.
